# OpenCode Workbench

> Open-source (MIT) MCP server and reproducible configuration that provisions a complete, self-documenting, and recoverable OpenCode development workstation onto any Linux machine — locally or over SSH. Ships the OpenCode config, agent skills, and the MCP stack; the MCP server clones the whole setup onto a target host.

## Connect

- Hosted MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://opencode-workbench.simonmak.com/mcp
- Local stdio server: `npx -y @simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench`
- Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench`
- Context7 library ID: `/simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench`

## MCP tools

- `describe_workbench`: describe the server — repo, components by tier, optional MCP add-ons
- `inspect_target`: probe a machine (OS, arch, package manager, Node, Docker, OpenCode)
- `plan_clone`: diff a target against the profile → install / present / manual steps
- `apply_clone`: consent-gated clone + install of the profile (idempotent)
- `verify_clone`: re-check config, env template, and every component
- `install_component`: install a single component by id (consent-gated)
- `remove_component`: uninstall a single component by id (consent-gated)
- `update_component`: update a single component in place (consent-gated)
- `list_required_credentials`: value-blind list of missing credentials
- `run_auth_flow`: emit-and-verify acquisition guidance for one credential
